summary: Skydance Corporation (f/k/a Paramount Skydance Corp) filed an 8-K confirming completion on October 6, 2026 of its previously announced February 27, 2026 merger with Warner Bros. Discovery, with Merger Sub merging into WBD as a wholly owned Skydance subsidiary. Skydance issued Class B shares to PIPE equity investors, issued roughly $41.4 billion of first- and second-lien secured notes, moved its listing to the NYSE and changed its ticker from PSKY to SKYD. The filing also discloses officer/director changes, bylaw amendments and shareholder votes; no board recommendation or advisor is named in the excerpt. Watch integration execution, leverage from the debt stack, and share overhang.
